text: 金十数据10月30日讯，2026年10月27日至29日，中越边境地区地面无线电业务频率协调会谈在云南省昆明市举行。会谈期间，双方本着友好协商、互利共赢的原则，就中越边境地区4G/5G公众移动通信系统相关频段的频率协调达成了一系列共识，并就无线电频率管理政策和2027年世界无线电通信大会议题观点进行了深入交流，为维护中越双方边境地区电波秩序、保障各类无线电业务正常运行奠定基础。本次会谈，中方代表团由工业和信息化部无线电管理局、广西壮族自治区工业和信息化厅、云南省工业和信息化厅、国家无线电监测中心、四家基础电信运营企业等单位组成。越南代表团由越南科学技术部无
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 30 - From October 27 to 29, 2026, a meeting on coordination of terrestrial radio service frequencies in the China-Vietnam border area was held in Kunming, Yunnan Province. During the meeting, the two sides, in the spirit of friendly consultation and mutual benefit, reached a series of consensus on frequency coordination for relevant frequency bands of 4G/5G public mobile communication systems in the China-Vietnam border area, and held in-depth exchanges on radio frequency management policies and views on topics for the 2027 World Radiocommunication Conference, laying the foundation for maintaining radio wave order in the border areas of both sides and ensuring the normal operation of various radio services. The Chinese delegation consisted of units including the Radio Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Department of Industry and Information Technology of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, the Department of Industry and Information Technology of Yunnan Province, the National Radio Monitoring Center, and four basic telecom operators.
